How fantasy fans keep a Turkish blacksmithing tradition alive
In Izmir’s historic Kemeralti bazaar, the Akdemir family is finding new customers for a four-generation craft.
Suleyman Akdemir holds a steel fantasy sword, inspired by World of Warcraft, at the Kemeralti forge where his family has practised blacksmithing for generations [Sinan Keskin/Al Jazeera]

Kemeralti Bazaar, Izmir, Turkiye – To the casual passer-by, the Akdemir family’s workshop could be any traditional blacksmith’s forge. Dozens of hammers and tongs hang from the walls; kebab skewers, knives and axes lie across the benches; a length of steel glows in the fire. But for those familiar with fantasy worlds and gaming, a second look may be required.
